Blocked root hands retain sentinel strengths and remain in the root span. No fabricated ranks or candidate-versus-itself oracle.

checks.device_inputs_and_outputs: probe.rs64-89 uploads fresh identical inputs per variant, launches one full entry, synchronizes, checks every output guard and all21 device input buffers against original host bits, including padding. Parent loop compares every baseline/candidate output word, not only active summaries. Full output arrays and hashes are preserved for every completed pair; first failure aborts rather than dropping/retuning a case.
checks.anti_vacuity_and_zero: All active root words must overwrite the stale finite guard. Absent-from-river own hands are zeroed; m_p0 with positive root nh still has active zero spans. All-zero/empty-valid cases require exact+0. count0 leaves the entire output untouched. Nonzero outputs are required for targetm>=127 nonzero profiles; tiny m1 may validly be zero. Injected expected-bit/guard verifier errors are separately labelled host checks.

checks.nonfinite_outputs: Every observed output bit must match; active NaN/Inf bits, if produced from finite inputs, are separately recorded. No approximate comparison or nonfinite exclusion.
checks.runtime_assessor: Requires exactly151 ordered markers and148 raw records matching frozen case order; independently recomputes complete-array equality, guards, active/nonzero counts, input-word counts, fingerprints and nonfinite records. It verifies terminal totals and reviewed PTX before writing a terminal exact report. It does not authorize E026 or accept performance.
checks.execution_lifetime: One-shot exclusive outputs, pinned artifacts/dependencies/references and full162 source map before/after; D050 terminal PASS required. Shared GPU lock, readonly live-idle refusal,51GiB disk requirement,600s stage bounds, no telemetry polling during native work, hidden owned child and cleanup while lock remains held. limits: Review is source/file-only. No rustc, NVRTC, native probe, kernel or solver was executed by reviewer; no checkout or status edits.
